blocked_analysis.analysis: Credential-setting purpose is identifiable. Account, operation, protected secret and lifecycle are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines a non-disclosing credential lifecycle and prevents fixed secrets, unsafe readback assumptions, protected-account changes or unrecovered lockout.
independent_technical_reasoning: A password cannot be validated by reading it back; the only meaningful functional oracle is authentication using the newly set secret through a protected path. Because even a transport failure may have applied the write, cleanup must rotate or revoke based on account state rather than blindly retrying the same command.
